name: Penal Worlder benefits
summary: 4.3 Penal Worlder A convict, survivor, conscript, or former prisoner. Allowed Species: Human, Ogryn, Ratling. Skill Proficiency: Survival and one of Athletics, Deception, or Intimidation. Hard Time: You have advantage on saving throws against exhaustion caused by forced marches, starvation, poor conditions, or sleep deprivation. Dirty Survival: Once per long rest, when you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you may drop to 1 hit point instead.
